title: Tepna — Physiological-Signal Analysis Suite
description: Tepna is a fleet of single-signal physiological analyzers (OxyDex oximetry, HRVDex HRV summaries, PulseDex raw RR-to-HRV, GlucoDex CGM, ECGDex raw ECG, PpgDex PPG, CPAPDex device data, MotionDex inertial motion) that emit onto a shared event bus and are fused by an Integrator layer. Every analyzer runs 100% locally in the browser — no network, no accounts, no data upload — and produces evidence-graded, reproducible metrics with a unified floating wall-clock time model.
